title: Activating More Pixels in Image Super-Resolution Transformer
grouping: A two-row grid with one column per method, method names centred above (EDSR, RCAN, SwinIR, HAT (Ours)). The first column holds the reference: the HR image with a small red box marking the patch, and the LR input. Rotated row labels on the left of the method columns name the rows ('LAM Attribution', 'SR Results'); a score is printed under every tile (DI under the attribution maps, PSNR (dB) / SSIM under the results, with those metric names under the first column).
shapes_depth: Borderless square image tiles only. Attribution maps are white with red heat; SR crops carry a green square marking the inspected patch. Plain serif numbers, no arrows or boxes.
proposed_highlight: The proposed method takes the last column, labelled '(Ours)', with its scores in bold; its attribution map is visibly the most widely spread.
lesson: Make the result-idea teaser a two-row grid with one column per method - an attribution heatmap above the output crop, a score printed under each tile - and put your method last with its numbers in bold.
notes: elements 'other' = attribution heatmaps. It is Figure 2 (Figure 1 is a bar chart). Venue not verified here (remembered as CVPR 2023), so venue = arXiv and year = arXiv preprint year. The figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the whole raster.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
